intro.title: Build test data factory and cleanup utilities
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a test data factory and cleanup utilities to streamline your testing workflow. You'll learn how to create reusable functions that generate mock data for your Node.js applications, ensuring consistent and isolated test scenarios. The core programming concept involves using factory functions and object manipulation to produce structured test data on demand. You'll work with JavaScript objects, arrays, and functions, and implement cleanup logic to reset data between tests. By the end, you'll have practical tools to make your tests more efficient and maintainable.
intro.usecase: Test data factories are essential in real-world applications like e-commerce platforms, where developers need to generate realistic product listings, user profiles, and order histories for testing checkout flows. In financial dashboards, these utilities create mock transaction data to validate reporting features without touching production databases. When building social media features, factories generate user posts and comments to test moderation tools and feed algorithms. Cleanup utilities ensure test environments remain isolated, preventing data leaks between test suites in CI/CD pipelines for enterprise applications.
